tasks.title: Review and ensure mobile responsive implementation
tasks.description:
Review the existing mobile responsive implementation and ensure it works correctly:

1. Read and analyze existing responsive CSS:
   - src/components/Calculator.css
   - src/components/Button.css
   - src/components/Display.css
   - src/App.css

2. Check for proper viewport meta tag in index.html

3. Verify media queries are properly implemented for:
   - Small mobile (320px-375px)
   - Standard mobile (375px-414px)
   - Tablets (768px-1024px)
   - Desktop (1024px+)

4. Test the responsive design by starting the dev server and using Playwright to capture screenshots on multiple device sizes

5. Fix any issues found in the CSS or layout to ensure:
   - Touch-friendly button sizes (minimum 44x44px)
   - Readable text on all screen sizes
   - Proper spacing and layout adaptation
   - No horizontal scrolling on mobile

6. Update or create tests in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx to verify responsive behavior

7. Take screenshots to verify correct rendering:
   - iPhone SE (375x667)
   - iPhone 12 Pro (390x844)
   - Pixel 5 (393x851)
   - iPad (768x1024)
   - Desktop (1920x1080)

Save screenshots to .eunomia/screenshots/developer/
acceptance_criteria: All media queries are properly defined and functional
Calculator displays correctly on mobile devices (375px-414px width)
Calculator displays correctly on tablets (768px-1024px width)
Calculator displays correctly on desktop (1024px+ width)
All buttons are touch-friendly on mobile (minimum 44x44px tap targets)
Text is readable on all screen sizes
Screenshots verify correct rendering on all target devices

tasks.title: Validate mobile responsive design
tasks.description:
Validate that the calculator is fully responsive on mobile devices:

1. Run the full test suite: npm test
2. Verify all tests pass, especially responsive tests in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx
3. Review screenshots in .eunomia/screenshots/developer/ to confirm responsive design works correctly
4. Verify the application renders correctly on:
   - Small mobile devices (375px width)
   - Standard mobile devices (390px-414px width)
   - Tablets (768px width)
   - Desktop (1920px width)
5. Confirm no layout breaking issues exist and all touch targets are appropriately sized
acceptance_criteria: Visual verification shows correct layout on all device sizes
No layout breaking issues on mobile devices
